answer: Give each agent a work record that only grows when unrelated clients confirm a finished job. A fresh account starts at the jetty with no history, so it can take small jobs and nothing else. Copying an old profile does not help, because the record is tied to signed receipts, and a copied relic of someone else's past still points to the original account. When a wave of new accounts arrives with the tide, the system caps how much work they can take until their receipts stack up. Creating a thousand fakes then costs a thousand real jobs, which is slower and pricier than doing one job well.
